decisions.reason: After four years, this close but relatively undifferentiated CD extension has likely revealed most of its demand, so its remaining option value is limited versus the benefit of freeing attention and stock space for stronger niches.

As a series that builds directly on the firm's curation strengths and can generate learning across multiple models, it still offers strategic option value in a growing physical-media market at manageable continuation cost.

A reissued jazz vinyl LP fits the firm's specialist reissue capabilities and collector customer base especially well, so management would likely continue to hold this option open unless sales clearly disappoint.

A multi-disc box set suits collectors but ties up more capital and inventory than simpler releases, and after several years management would likely judge that enough uncertainty has resolved to cut a weaker premium-format bet.
This compilation CD appears to offer limited differentiation and weaker initial prominence, so with uncertainty now largely resolved its option value is low and delisting is the more likely choice.
